name: nested-branch-inside-branch-valid
description: a valid branch step nested two levels deep inside another branch case's `do`, proving the schema's full-depth recursion does not reject a runtime-valid script.
yaml:
appId: com.example.app
name: Nested branch
env: {}
proxy: required
---
- launchApp
- capture: "POST /api/x as: resp"
- branch:
    from: resp
    on:
      - match: { status: 200 }
        do:
          - branch:
              from: resp
              on:
                - match: { status: 200 }
                  do:
                    - tap: "Confirm"
              default:
                - screenshot: inner-default
    default:
      - screenshot: outer-default
